definitions.gloss: preserved food; long-lasting food; emergency rations
definitions.explanation: Food that has been processed or prepared to last a long time without spoiling. Includes canned goods, dried foods, freeze-dried meals, and disaster preparedness supplies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{非常用|ひじょうよう}→非常用：28550_hijouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保存食|ほぞんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}えている→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: I keep emergency preserved food on hand.

examples.japanese: {保存食|ほぞんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しよう→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's regularly check the expiration dates on preserved food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保存食|ほぞんしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おいしく⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Modern preserved food comes in a wide variety of flavors, making it possible to eat well even during disasters.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (preservation, storage) and {食|しょく} (food).

In Japan, {保存食|ほぞんしょく} is particularly associated with disaster preparedness (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧). Households are encouraged to keep a supply of preserved food for earthquakes and other emergencies.

Traditional Japanese preserved foods include ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickles), ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧ (dried fish), and ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧ (pickled plums).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保存食|ほぞんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stockpile preserved food)
- ⟦{非常用|ひじょうよう}→非常用：28550_hijouyou⟧{保存食|ほぞんしょく} (emergency preserved food)
- ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧{保存食|ほぞんしょく} (long-term preserved food)
